verdict.rationale: Graphite ships AI agents (Graphite Agent, Chat, Agents), so plugging MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents GT MCP, which is Graphite acting as an MCP server for other AI agents. That is the opposite role, and nothing shows Graphite's own agents connecting to or using external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
